description.narrative:
The Activity will support enhanced longer-term marketing of the destination and tourism products, as well as support industry COVID-19 protocols, quality standards and strengthen sustainable tourism sector planning. The Activity will focus on three key areas;
  • Supporting sector planning and coordination to enable future sustainable tourism growth.
  • Enhancing COVID-19 visitor safety and developing quality tourism products
  • Enhancing communications and on-line tourism marketing.
